scope: First native task-board human Inbox slice. Fixture API, persistent journal, Ink and real disposable PTY verification. Actual-human live decision test of this board is pending.
entryPoint: npm run board, node src/cli.mjs tui, or installed herdr-relay tui
capabilities: Human questions, exact candidate reviews and reminders in one task-linked Inbox.
Task Actions and Inbox share the same fresh-preview, edit and explicit-confirmation component.
Executing agent is displayed separately from human responsibility.
Agents has a separate read-only view with mode, owning node, workspace, reported availability and last seen.
Node and reported machine labels remain distinct in agent, task and human decision context.
Optional machine heartbeat metadata is owned by the reporting node and capability-gated for older backends.
Task rows describe admission, waits, continuation eligibility and review without claiming unobserved native execution.
Taskless scheduled reviews and standing-monitor reviews show their own effects.
Stable item-identity selection across refreshes and pinned decision previews.
Private durable decision journal with original-key retry across restart and backend identity fencing.
Uncertain or malformed receipts stay unconfirmed. Definitively refused operations require inspection and explicit dismissal.
Offline fetch time and cached state are explicit, not empty success.
liveMachineLabels: Not advertised: running backend/node processes have not been restarted to use the new optional metadata
limitations: No actual-human live Inbox decision is claimed for this new native board.
Advanced grant, transfer, adoption and local daemon recovery controls are not included in this slice.
Shared backend state does not contain every local native uncertainty or admission state.
Request changes does not automatically dispatch another ordinary worker turn.
Terminal-dialog provenance does not claim an OpenCode conversation or natural-chat source message.
Existing native work-pane processes must be reopened to load the changed board.
